cover_fields.explanatoryNotes: For security FirstService Corporation, symbol (FSV), Cusip 33767E202; our firm was unable to vote a proxy for this security as no proxy was generated either electronically with Proxy Edge/Broadridge or via paper ballot proxy. Our firm was told by the custodian Charles Schwab and Co., Inc. that "FSV is a Canadian security. Proxy Edge only supports domestics." Therefore this position was not voted due to no proxy being generated or provided to our firm, due to the foreign status of this security.
